text: ProductionSchedulingDB was created correctly and simply never joined to BrennanAG. This video fixes it properly, proves the fix, and closes the real gap behind it.

BrennanAG fails back to SQLDBA01 so the database being added is on the primary. A full backup, a restore WITH NORECOVERY on SQLDBA02, then ALTER AVAILABILITY GROUP ADD DATABASE -- the same mechanism that joined BrennanERP.
The same failover test runs again. This time ProductionSchedulingDB follows the AG with zero changes on the application side -- the fix is proven, not assumed.

The real root cause wasn't carelessness -- creating and AG-joining a database are two separate manual steps, and the second got missed during routine work. A nightly script now compares every database against AG membership.
The database is protected, and this exact class of gap can't recur silently. Next: turning this whole incident into a report leadership can actually trust.
